integrity: All proofs and checks are presented with their limitations; no independent mathematical validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The logarithmic tail exponent and the sharp exponential-moment threshold are proved for positive coefficients with original cubic-flow time and uniform spherical area; no tail prefactor or period monotonicity is asserted. The classical weighted-product integral and periodicity are prior work.
title: Sharp long-period tails on cubic Kolmogorov sphere flows
